context: Playwright ships a CLI for coding agents, an MCP server, and planner/generator/healer Test Agents. Predicted baseline failure: the answer adds Playwright MCP as asked, without weighing context cost, and either does not know `npx playwright init-agents --loop=claude` or skips the seed test and the regenerate-on-upgrade rule.

checklist.name: CLI recommended for occasional checks
checklist.description: Recommends playwright-cli (@playwright/cli) for occasional checks from Claude Code, with MCP positioned for long-running or MCP-only loops.

checklist.name: Reason is context cost
checklist.description: Explains that MCP tool schemas and accessibility snapshots load into the conversation, while the CLI keeps them out.

checklist.name: Correct install commands
checklist.description: Gives `npm install -g @playwright/cli@latest` (or the bundled `npx playwright cli`) and, if MCP is mentioned, `claude mcp add playwright npx @playwright/mcp@latest`.

checklist.name: Test Agents setup
checklist.description: Gives `npx playwright init-agents --loop=claude` and names what it writes: planner, generator and healer definitions under .claude/agents/, .mcp.json, seed.spec.ts.

checklist.name: Seed and upgrade rules
checklist.description: Says to put the real setup (fixtures, sign-in) in seed.spec.ts and to re-run init-agents whenever @playwright/test is upgraded.

checklist.name: Healer output reviewed
checklist.description: Says healer changes need human review, because it may change expected values or mark tests test.fixme.
